report_discrepancies.note: Statement of Activities prints business-type Net Position - Beginning 1,299,681,369 and Change in Net Position 93,891,088, while the proprietary funds statement (p11) prints beginning 1,299,681,366 and change 93,891,091; both print ending 1,393,572,457. business_type uses the p11 figures, which roll forward exactly.

notes: GAAP. Governmental: Total column of the Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Fund Balances - Governmental Funds (p4); ending_cash = cash and cash equivalents from the governmental funds Balance Sheet Total column (p3), investments 483,915,748 in ending_investments for information; beginning cash not shown. debt_proceeds = Issuance of Debt 24,561,781; other_financing = Subscriptions 304,755 + Sale of Capital Assets 577,888. Statement 'Debt Service' and 'Debt Service P & I' lines are not split by principal/interest on p4, so they are recorded as debt service (principal and interest combined); the statement 'Capital Outlay' line prints no function (Total column). Business-type: Total enterprise column of the proprietary Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Fund Net Position (p11), internal service funds excluded; no single total printed, so totals = operating + nonoperating lines (negative nonoperating lines shown as positive expenses; the positive Gain (Loss) on Disposal 118,258 is a receipt); other_financing = capital contributions less plant costs recovered. Proprietary cash flows p12 Total column. governmental_net_position from the Statement of Activities (p2). Balance sheet: government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1), Governmental and Business-type columns per line, totals from the Total column. Detail (same structure as Lincoln_FY2024): General, Street Construction, West Haymarket JPA and Federal Grants funds from the p4 fund columns, so detail ties to p4; the budget-basis schedules (p5 General Fund, p6 Street Construction, pp7-8 Federal Grants) and the General Fund combining schedule (p14, sub-funds) cover the same funds on a different basis and are not used to avoid double counting; nonmajor special revenue funds per fund column (17 funds, pp16-17), nonmajor debt service (p18), capital projects (p19) and permanent (p20) funds per fund; the p15 nonmajor-by-type statement is the sum of these and is not used. Zero/dash cells omitted. No business-type detail (the trim has no enterprise fund schedules). Trim contents (report page numbers): 35 SNP, 36 SoA, 37 gov Balance Sheet, 38 gov SREF, 40 GF budget, 42 Street budget, 43-44 Federal Grants budget, 45-46 proprietary SNP, 48 proprietary SRECNP, 49-50 proprietary cash flows, 122 GF combining SREF, 125 nonmajor by type, 131-132 nonmajor special revenue, 136 nonmajor debt service, 140 nonmajor capital projects, 144 nonmajor permanent, 208-210 statistical tables (no figures used). Looks cut off / not in trim: report pp39 (fund-to-SoA reconciliation), 41 and 47 (reconciliations), the combining balance sheets (pp121-143 gaps), and everything between report pp144 and 208 (nonmajor enterprise fund combining statements for Golf, Parking, Arena, Solid Waste, EMS, Broadband; internal service and fiduciary combining statements; any West Haymarket or other budget schedules), so business-type detail by fund is not available.
